cross_checked_corrections: Dielectric Specular Tint is artistic control; do not label a warm tint measured leather optics
Coat Weight is not coating thickness; intermediate visual-fit values are not measured coverage
Area-light same power does not prove identical surface irradiance; inspect Normalize and geometry
Planar reflection-width estimate is not a universal rough-surface or curved-product formula
An OIDN OFF preview does not by itself establish that the denoiser generated coherent grain
Do not infer Blender internal cleanAux/prefilter implementation from generic OIDN API options
